protocol.build_provenance_trust: Operator declarations cross-checked against binary and matching source bytes; not independent build attestation. git_revision labels matching source, not necessarily actual historical build commit.
protocol.clock: local request/notification preparation through complete matching response; includes position/prefix/JSON work, IO and concurrent sampler overhead; oracle and cleanup excluded
protocol.disk: fresh native job per query, likely warm filesystem cache; not incremental query timing
protocol.initialization: one initialize-request observation per project/variant after Popen; not full process startup or seven-sample startup timing

definition.query_buffer: original disk bytes captured by didOpen
definition.target_buffer: original disk bytes plus the latest measured prefix

protocol.memory: sampled process-group RSS sum including broker/supervisor/worker when observed; /proc reads are non-atomic, shared pages double-counted, brief peaks/processes may be missed; availability alone does not prove all three were observed; not unique physical memory or a quota
protocol.order: serial project/workload pairs; baseline/candidate order reverses each round
protocol.scope: Two successful fixed source definitions and one-line target-buffer edits; not full semantic acceptance.
